create_EMGSessionData: create an EMGSessionData instance from an HDF5 file to access EMG timeseries and keystroke metadata
slice_EMGSessionData: slice EMG timeseries data by start and end timestamps using EMGSessionData slice method
create_LabelData_from_keystrokes: create a LabelData instance from a sequence of keystroke dicts with optional timestamp filtering
create_LabelData_from_prompts: create a LabelData instance from a sequence of prompt dicts with optional newline enforcement
create_WindowedEMGDataset: create a WindowedEMGDataset from an HDF5 path with configurable window length, stride, and jitter
